title: feat: bound queue batches
body: The worker previously drained the entire pending queue into each send. Add a configurable batch limit, defaulting to 100, so each send receives at most that many jobs. Leave remaining jobs queued for later drains. Validate the setting at startup. This bounds batch size, not job memory or processing time. Per-tenant scheduling is out of scope because the queue currently has no tenant key. No alternatives or follow-up issues are documented.
